highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.1 prevents partial glyph-atlas updates from reusing stale glyph locations.

bullets.lead: Partial updates do not validate the whole atlas
bullets.detail: Corrects glyph-vector generation tracking when earlier glyphs may have been evicted between flushes, avoiding the stale-location fast path.

v4.152.1.headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.1 prevents partial glyph-atlas updates from reusing evicted glyph locations.
